label.ru: Опровержение, лист G, лицевая сторона (лист скана 53)

texts.en: Now for the Poet, he nothing affirmeth, and therefore neuer lieth: for as I take it, to lie, is to affirme that to bee true, which is false.

refs: First edition (London 1595), sig. G recto, unpaginated

label.ru: Опровержение, лист G, лицевая сторона (лист скана 53)

texts.en: And therefore though he recount things not true, yet because he telleth them not for true, he lieth not: without we will say, that Nathan lied in his speech before alleaged to Dauid, which as a wicked man durst scarce say, so think I none so simple, wold say, that Esope lied, in the tales of his beasts: for who thinketh that Esope wrote it for actually true, were wel worthie to haue his name Cronicled among the beasts he writeth of.

refs: First edition (London 1595), sig. G recto, unpaginated
